mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month and retail sales (RSAFS) are below their 12-month moving average, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST MoM < -10% and RSAFS < 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month during a period of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO MoM > 1% and UNRATE < 4%.
